name: Aliamin Auto Internal Linker
author: Yevhen Aliamin

sections.description:
Aliamin Auto Internal Linker builds internal links automatically by analyzing your post titles and injecting relevant links directly into your content in real-time.

No manual linking. No bulk editing. No database changes.

Your content is already written — now make it work.

This plugin is designed for SEO-focused websites that want to improve internal linking structure without spending hours on manual optimization.

Unlike traditional internal linking plugins, this tool:
– Works dynamically (no permanent changes to your content)
– Extracts meaningful keywords from post titles
– Generates multi-word anchor links
– Keeps your database clean
– Avoids over-optimization

Just activate it — and your site becomes internally connected.

Features

  • Smart keyword extraction from post titles
  • Automatic multi-word anchor linking
  • Real-time link injection (no database modification)
  • Works with any WordPress theme
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Zero configuration required
  • SEO-friendly linking behavior

Why Aliamin Auto Internal Linker

Most internal linking plugins either require manual setup, modify your content permanently, or generate unnatural links.

Aliamin Auto Internal Linker takes a different approach.

It builds links dynamically and naturally — like a human SEO specialist would.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your WordPress site
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Done

Links will start appearing automatically inside your content.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin modify my posts?

No. Links are injected dynamically and your database remains unchanged.

Is this safe for SEO?

Yes. The plugin avoids over-linking and keeps anchor text natural.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes, it works with any properly coded WordPress theme.
